channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kamala Harris | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kamala Harris from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Craig Hodges on Kamala Harris
item.description:
“We can’t say that because it’s ‘politically incorrect.’ And then you wanna give me Kamala Harris? Nah, man.”

Craig Hodges on Kamala Harris, May 13, 2025. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kamala Harris, Tim Waltz
item.description:
Kendra Andrews:Kerr:

“The joy, the compassion, the commitment to our country that we saw at the Olympics, that is what Kamala Harris and Tim Waltz has. And it’s what our country needs. Leadership. Real leadership.”

Steve Kerr on Kamala Harris, Tim Waltz, Aug 20, 2024. Source: Twitter @kendra__andrews.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Kamala Harris
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr:

“We're taking great pride in the fact that Kamala Harris is from Oakland. ... It was a great day.”

Steve Kerr on Kamala Harris, Jan 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Joe Biden, Kamala Harris
item.description:
Ky Carlin:Doc Rivers:

“This country needs healing. I hope that Joe Biden and Kamala Harris can do it, because we need it.”

Doc Rivers on Joe Biden, Kamala Harris, Jan 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @Ky_Carlin.
